description:
Port the Container pattern from pi-tui's tui.ts. The upstream TUI uses Container as the fundamental building block — components nest children, each rendering into lines that are stacked vertically.

Implement:
- Container struct with ordered children list
- render/2 concatenates children's rendered lines
- add_child/remove_child/clear_children
- Invalidation propagation (child invalidate → parent re-render)

This is the foundation for all composite components (AssistantMessage, ToolExecution, etc.)

Upstream: packages/tui/src/tui.ts (Container class)
title: Container component: nested child layout with invalidation
